name: Ethical Hacker
title: Ethical Hacker / Penetration Tester
intro: From Class 12 to a penetration tester: a computer degree, hands-on skills in legal labs and CTFs, reputable certifications, a first SOC or VAPT role, then red-team and security-architect work — always with written authorisation.

phases.title: Class 12
phases.summary: PCM keeps B.Tech open; BCA and B.Sc IT often accept any stream with Maths.
points: BCA and B.Sc IT often accept Commerce or Arts students with Maths.
Self-taught skills count heavily in this field.

phases.title: Computer degree
phases.summary: B.Tech CSE, BCA or B.Sc IT.
points: A degree in computer science, IT or BCA is the usual base.
Strong self-learners from other backgrounds also break in.
Use the degree years to learn networking and programming deeply.

phases.title: Build legal, hands-on skills
phases.summary: Networks, Linux, web security and scripting, practised in legal labs and CTFs.
points: Hands-on skill in networking, Linux, web technologies and scripting is what employers test.
Practise only in legal labs, CTFs and company bug-bounty programmes that legally reward reported vulnerabilities.
Always work under a written authorisation from the system owner.
phases.tip: Testing a website or network without written permission is an offence under the IT Act, 2000 — even if you mean well.

phases.title: Certifications and first job
phases.summary: Reputable hands-on certifications help; SOC analyst or junior VAPT tester is the common start.
points: Private certifications from international bodies are valued but optional; none is a Government licence — check how hands-on they are before paying.
Common first roles: SOC analyst or junior VAPT tester.
Employers: CERT-In empanelled audit firms, IT services, banks, fintechs, product companies and consultancies.

phases.title: Grow
phases.summary: Penetration tester, red-team lead, security consultant.
points: Growth path: SOC analyst → pentester → senior / red team → security architect / CISO.
Experienced testers are in short supply; skill and reputation drive pay.
CERT-In, the national agency for cyber-security incidents, empanels security-audit organisations; bug-bounty research can run alongside a job.
